segments.caption: A man in a white shirt stands beside a dark green Skoda estate car parked on a rural road, speaking directly to the camera. He gestures with his hands as he talks, and a subtitle appears, advising viewers that the tutorial is only a guide. The setting is outdoors on a sunny day, with trees and grass visible in the background.

A man in a white shirt stands outside a car, speaking directly to the camera with a disclaimer text overlay, before transitioning to sit inside the driver’s seat. The camera then focuses on close-up shots of the car’s gear shift lever, highlighting its design and features.

A man in a light blue shirt is inside a car, speaking to the camera while demonstrating features. He then moves to the side of the vehicle, now wearing a high-visibility vest, and kneels beside the front wheel to point out details of the alloy rim, indicating a car review or feature showcase.

A man is driving when his car sustains damage to the front bumper and wheel, likely from a collision. He exits the vehicle, dons a high-visibility vest, and inspects the damage while speaking to the camera. The video concludes with a promotion for ŠKODA Roadside Assistance, displaying the contact number over an image of a warning triangle, indicating the need for professional help.

A driver has broken down on the roadside and is now retrieving emergency equipment from the car's trunk. He takes out a warning triangle and a reflective vest, preparing to make the vehicle visible to other drivers. The video also displays the ŠKODA Roadside Assistance phone number, 0800 526 625, as a resource for help.

A man in an orange high-visibility vest demonstrates how to use a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) solution bottle to check and maintain tire pressure on a car. He first shows a red and white "max 50 mph" warning sticker, then opens the solution bottle and inserts its nozzle into the tire valve stem to inflate or adjust pressure, all while kneeling beside the vehicle on the roadside.

A man in an orange high-visibility vest kneels by a car on the side of a road, using a portable air pump to inflate a flat tire. He carefully attaches the pump's nozzle to the valve stem, then begins pumping air into the tire to restore its pressure.

A man in an orange high-visibility vest crouches beside a dark green car on the side of a road, demonstrating how to inflate a tire using a portable air compressor. He connects the nozzle to the valve stem, operates the device, and then removes it, completing the task.
A man in a safety vest kneels by a car, preparing to inflate a tire using a portable air compressor he retrieves from a blue case.

A man in a high-visibility vest crouches beside a car, retrieving a portable air compressor from a blue case. He plugs in the device’s cigarette lighter adapter, then connects the hose to the car’s tire valve stem to inflate the tire.

A man in an orange safety vest kneels beside a car on the roadside, using a portable blue air compressor to inflate a tire. He connects the hose to the valve stem, operates the compressor, and checks the pressure gauge, all while speaking to the camera, likely explaining the process or offering safety advice.

A man in an orange safety vest kneels beside a black car, appearing distressed as he attempts to jump-start it using jumper cables connected to a portable battery. He then stands and speaks directly to the camera, likely explaining the situation or the car's issue, with the open trunk and a diesel fuel cap visible in the background.

A man in an orange safety vest stands by an open car trunk, speaking directly to the camera. He then retrieves a tire inflator from the trunk and proceeds to inflate a tire, checking the pressure. After finishing, he gets into the driver's seat and continues speaking, likely explaining the process or offering advice on car maintenance.

A man in a car explains the importance of checking tire pressure, showing a close-up of a tire and a pressure gauge, while referencing a manual that emphasizes how tire pressure affects vehicle handling and longevity.

A driver is advised to take immediate, cautious action due to a tire pressure issue: drive no faster than 50mph, accelerate, brake, and corner gently, as this is a temporary measure requiring prompt attention from a ŠKODA or tire retailer.
A man is shown driving a car while visibly distressed and speaking with an anxious expression, set against a backdrop of greenery outside the vehicle.

A man with dark, curly hair sits in the driver's seat of a car, looking toward the camera and speaking. The background outside the car window shows green foliage, indicating a roadside or rural setting. The video then transitions to text screens providing customer support information: first, advising viewers to contact RAC for Skoda Roadside Assistance if they are unsure about using the kit, and second, informing viewers that they can purchase a spare wheel and kit by contacting their local Skoda

This segment provides Skoda customers with support information. It reassures users who are unsure about using their roadside kit that they can call RAC for Skoda Roadside Assistance. It also informs customers who wish to purchase a spare wheel and kit to contact their local Skoda retailer. The segment concludes by displaying key contact details — the Skoda UK website, the roadside assistance phone number, and the customer services number — before ending with the Skoda logo.
